nodes.description: address public manager; privileged owner, set to msg.sender in constructor
address public coOwner; set in constructor from constructor argument coown
mapping(address => bool) public hasAids; written based on block.timestamp condition
Ho[8] public hoes; fixed array of structs holding pimp, buyPrice, rentPrice, aidsChance
Constructor Brothel(address coown); initializes manager, coOwner and all hoes pricing
withdraw() public restricted; splits balance 23% to coOwner and remainder to manager
buyHo(uint index) public payable; pays current pimp, takes ownership, reprices ho
rentHo(uint index) public payable; pays current pimp rent and may mark renter with aids
setRentPrice(uint index, uint newPrice) public; only the current pimp may update rent price
sendMoney() public payable restricted; accepts ether only from manager
balance() public view returns(uint); returns contract balance
msg.sender; external caller that controls ownership, withdrawals and access checks
block.timestamp; miner-influenced value used to decide aids infection
coOwner.transfer(leBron); external value transfer inside withdraw
manager.transfer(address(this).balance); external full-balance transfer inside withdraw
currentPimp.transfer(msg.value*93/100); external value transfer inside buyHo
currentPimp.transfer(msg.value*93/100); external value transfer inside rentHo
uint leBron = address(this).balance*23/100; balance arithmetic in withdraw
hoe.buyPrice = msg.value*160/100; price arithmetic in buyHo
basePrice*(i+1), hoe.buyPrice/10 and baseAidsChance+(i*4) price arithmetic in constructor
block.timestamp%hoe.aidsChance == 0; timestamp-dependent outcome in rentHo
require(msg.sender == hoes[index].pimp); authorization check in setRentPrice
modifier restricted: require(msg.sender == manager); shared authorization guard
constructor parameter coown; initial owner candidate
buyHo parameter index; selects ho to purchase
rentHo parameter index; selects ho to rent
setRentPrice parameter index; selects ho to reprice
setRentPrice parameter newPrice; attacker-supplied rent price
uint basePrice = 0.002 ether; constructor price seed
uint size = hoes.length; constructor loop bound
uint baseAidsChance = 7; constructor aids chance seed
uint i; constructor loop counter
uint leBron; co-owner share computed in withdraw
address currentPimp; recipient of payment in buyHo
uint currentPrice; required payment threshold in buyHo
address currentPimp; recipient of payment in rentHo
uint currentRent; required payment threshold in rentHo

edges.reason: Constructor assigns manager = msg.sender, giving the caller privileged control
Constructor argument coown initializes the coOwner state variable
restricted modifier compares msg.sender against manager
restricted modifier guards withdraw, limiting it to manager
restricted modifier guards sendMoney, limiting ether deposits to manager
setRentPrice trusts msg.sender to be the pimp recorded in hoes[index]
require on msg.sender gates the state update in setRentPrice
Aids outcome depends on block.timestamp, which is miner-influenced
hasAids[msg.sender] is set only when the timestamp modulo condition holds
hasAids mapping is keyed by the caller msg.sender
buyHo writes hoe.pimp = msg.sender, transferring ownership to the caller
leBron local is produced by the balance*23/100 computation
The computed leBron amount flows into coOwner.transfer
withdraw transfers the remaining contract balance to manager
msg.value*160/100 is written back into hoes[index].buyPrice
Unvalidated index parameter addresses hoes array element in buyHo
Unvalidated index parameter addresses hoes array element in rentHo
Unvalidated index parameter addresses hoes array element in setRentPrice
currentPimp read from hoes[index] becomes the external transfer recipient in buyHo
currentPimp read from hoes[index] becomes the external transfer recipient in rentHo
basePrice feeds the initial buyPrice computation
baseAidsChance feeds the initial aidsChance computation
Loop counter i feeds the initial price and aids chance computations
size = hoes.length bounds the constructor pricing loop
newPrice parameter is written directly into hoes[index].rentPrice without bounds
Constructor loop performs unchecked multiplications on stored prices
withdraw computes the co-owner share with integer arithmetic
buyHo performs an external payment to the current pimp
buyHo recomputes buyPrice from msg.value with integer arithmetic
rentHo performs an external payment to the current pimp
rentHo branches on block.timestamp to decide infection
currentPrice from hoes[index] is compared against msg.value in buyHo
currentRent from hoes[index] is compared against msg.value in rentHo
coOwner.transfer is an external call made during withdraw; transfer stipend limits but does not remove the reentrant path
manager.transfer is an external call made during withdraw on a caller-controlled address
currentPimp.transfer is an external call during buyHo before ownership state is finalized
currentPimp.transfer is an external call during rentHo before the aids state write

normalization_plan.reason: index parameter only serves to select the array element operated on by buyHo
index parameter only serves to select the array element operated on by rentHo
index parameter only selects the ho whose rentPrice is modified in setRentPrice
newPrice parameter is the value written into hoes[index].rentPrice by setRentPrice
basePrice is only an operand of the constructor price arithmetic
size is a loop bound derived from hoes.length inside the constructor
baseAidsChance is only an operand of the constructor aids chance arithmetic
loop counter i is only used to compute stored prices in the constructor
leBron holds the result of the balance*23/100 arithmetic in withdraw
currentPimp is only read to be the recipient of the external transfer in buyHo
currentPrice is only used in the msg.value requirement check inside buyHo
currentPimp is only read to be the recipient of the external transfer in rentHo
currentRent is only used in the msg.value requirement check inside rentHo
